title: Quick Filipino Rice Noodles
description: A kid-friendly, pungent pancit bihon made in a Korean brass bowl using simple no-onion-no-garlic ingredients.
instructions: Boil 600ml of water in a saucepan until rolling boil.
Add the rice vermicelli to the boiling water and cook for 3 minutes, then drain and set aside in the Korean brass bowl.
Heat 1 tbsp of vegetable oil in a skillet over medium heat and add the diced chicken, cooking until no longer pink.
Add the shrimp to the skillet and cook until shrimp turn pink, about 2 minutes.
Stir in the julienned carrot, shredded cabbage, and frozen peas, sautéing until vegetables soften, about 3 minutes.
Pour in the soy sauce, fish sauce, and calamansi juice, then sprinkle the sugar, salt, and pepper, stirring to combine.
Add the drained noodles to the skillet, tossing everything together so the noodles absorb the sauces.
Reduce heat to low, then pour 1 tbsp of sesame oil over the noodles, and stir until the mixture is glossy and heated through.
Garnish with sliced spring onions, giving the dish a fresh, crunchy finish.
Serve immediately while hot, allowing the flavors to mingle in the Korean brass bowl.
